name: commit-gate-debug-four
purpose: Phase 4: does a cheap compiler act on the world's own commit report? Four Debugging tasks on which K2.7 reliably produces a workbook, so the gate has something to check. Run twice on the same seeds, identical except --commit-gate. Colour tasks are excluded: they run format-conventions observation and the gate's checks are formula-based.
success: Primary: fewer error cells in the output than the off arm. Exact is secondary and not expected. A finding acknowledged and repaired is the mechanism working; a finding read and dismissed is still informative.
